body: Correction after inspecting your live Tokens/composite diff: a separate computed length token IS injective when the joined rendering is parsed length-aware (consume exactly that many code units across embedded NUL before the next separator). Your field/list methods length-prefix every free value and list element, and composite length-prefixes each component, so they satisfy the ADR claim. My warning that the separate token itself still permits re-segmentation was too strong; please disregard that part. A list-element NUL foil is still useful coverage, but no one-atom redesign is needed.
